top_signals.title: Kumamoto’s foreign community leans on 2016 lessons after quake
top_signals.summary: The prefecture's foreign residents checked in with neighbors, translated information and warnings, and helped to secure emergency supplies after the 7.1 magnitude earthquake.

top_signals.title: ADNOC Drilling CEO: Setting New Industry Benchmarks
top_signals.summary: ADNOC Drilling reported profit for the second quarter that beat estimates. Profits rose 1.7% Y/Y to $357.1 million while revenue grew by 2.9%. Abdulla Ateya Al Messabi, ADNOC Drilling's CEO spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on the performance as well as future plans for the company. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co.’s sales increased more than expected, helped by hot weather in Europe boosting demand for brands like Ben & Jerry’s and Cornetto.

top_signals.title: Joint statement by European Commission and High Representative marking the 75th anniversary of the 1951 Convention relating to the Status of Refugees
top_signals.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 28 Jul 2026 Today, as we mark the 75th anniversary of the 1951 Convention relating to the Status of Refugees, the European Union reaffirms its full commitment to the Convention, to its values and principles, and to ensuring that refugee protection remains firmly anchored in EU and partner countries' legislation, international law and effective multilateral cooperation.
